Sarthak Lad

Email address –sarthaklad04@gmail.com

Contact No- +91 9769151795

OBJECTIVE:

As an engineering graduate with hands-on experience in Cisco Routers, Switches, SD-WAN, Wireless technologies, and real-time network troubleshooting, I have developed a strong foundation in the networking field. I am looking forward to working with companies where I can learn, work and grow professionally and personally.

SUMMARY:

Network Engineer with 4.8+ years of hands-on experience in managing, implementing, and troubleshooting enterprise network infrastructure.

Cisco CCNA certified and Cisco SD-WAN certified, currently pursuing CCNP Routing & Switching and Cisco SD-WAN training to further enhance technical expertise.

Proficient in supporting and resolving issues across Layer 2 and Layer 3 networks, ensuring



optimal performance and reliability. Skilled at engaging with stakeholders to deliver clear and accurate updates on projects, incidents, and service improvements.

Possess strong communication skills, both written and verbal, to collaborate effectively with customers, internal teams, and cross-functional units.

Demonstrated ability to resolve high-impact technical issues under pressure, maintaining service continuity and minimizing downtime.

Highly attentive to detail, capable of managing multiple technical priorities simultaneously in fast- paced environments.

Committed to customer satisfaction, with a strong service-oriented mindset and a focus on delivering quality support and solutions.

Working as Lead Engineer for (Latin America) region, handling critical network incidents



and service requests. Leading bridge calls with customers, ISP teams, and internal engineering teams for faster issue resolution.

Troubleshooting SD-WAN, routing, switching, MPLS, VPN related issues in real-time. - Performing L1/L2 network troubleshooting for enterprise WAN environment. - Coordinating with ISP providers for circuit outages, packet loss, latency and routing issues

SD-WAN SKILLS

Cisco SD-WAN Architecture (Controller-based design) - - WAN Edge router configuration (cEdge / vEdge) - - Application-Aware Routing (AAR) - TLOC & OMP routing concepts - SD-WAN overlay & underlay design

vManage, vSmart, vBond configuration & troubleshooting

VPN segmentation (VPN 0, 10, 512 etc.) - - - Troubleshooting SD-WAN fabric issues SD-WAN template configuration Software upgrade via vManage

WORK EXPERIENCE: June 2026

Horizontal Solution Ltd

Client : Infosys

* Designed and implemented Cisco Meraki network solutions for enterprise environments. - * Configured and deployed Meraki MX Security Appliances, MS Switches, and MR Access Points. - * Created and managed VLANs, DHCP, firewall rules, VPNs, and SD-WAN policies using the Meraki Dashboard.

* Performed network migrations, device onboarding, and remote site deployments. - * Troubleshot LAN/WAN connectivity, AP issues, VPN tunnels, and client connectivity problems. - * Coordinated with customers and cross-functional teams during implementation and change windows.

* Validated network performance and ensured successful post-implementation testing.

ACCENTURE CUSTOMER SERVICE ANALYST PRESENT

NOV 2024 –

Network Infrastructure Management: Configuring, monitoring, and maintaining Traditional and APIC Leaf Switches using APIC portal, Access Points, switches and routers for optimal network performance and scalability using Netcure, Statseeker and Service Now.

Communicating with the ISP for Higher level resolutions. - Understanding and resolving user-based issues. - VLAN configuration. - RMA switch replacement. - New switch configuration. - - Maintain comprehensive documentation for network configurations, incident reports to clients, including incident analysis, network health checks, and service metrics.



resolutions, troubleshooting procedures, and standard operating procedures (SOPs). Serve as the primary liaison between the client and Cisco support teams or third-party vendors to coordinate issue resolution and escalations.

Tata Communication IP-NOC 4755 Customer Service - Assurance Engineer (L2)

May 22 – Oct 24

Responsible for the equipment’s operation and maintenance (Fault, configuration, alarm,

performance, and security) or network components to drive network efficiency and availability.

Ensure efficient and effective technical customer service as per SLAs. Manage Technical Support Center

(helpdesk) and operations of escalation desk/tickets for all NOC and SOC issues.

- Review L3/L4 incidents and ensure resolution efficiency to ensure smooth operation and maintenance

of network components and other specified equipment to drive network efficiency and availability.

Tracks and monitor network traffic and performance to ensure minimal interruption to transmission

and/or network switches.

Ensure adequate monitoring of various network aspects planning across different service and ensuring

quick and appropriate resolution of network issues (remote as well as on-field).

Monitor vendor performance, particularly critical incidents, delayed cases, non- adherence to SLA,

etc. Lead implementation for any new network updates, Planned Activities and change Management.

Corrects network and SOC problems effectively and in a timely manner.

ICICI BANK Operation (SD-WAN and Non SD-WAN)

Onboarding of routers for NBR as well as RMA devices which include SD wan Viptela.

Versa and cisco traditional routers. - Creating DHCP scope for bank LAN networks in INFOBLOX. MAC binding and addition.



Support field engineers for Installation of new devices in network and IOS upgradation as per requirement Solar winds.

Execute downtime for CSP of old service provider on current devices.

Doing SDWAN Migration (Viptela and Versa) also doing relocation activities. Troubleshooting and

resolving the customer issues related to either at routing level or at access level depending on

different types of issue.



Trimax IT infrastructure & services ltd Network

Network Engineer cum field Engineer (L1)

July 21 -

May 22

Monitoring WAN Links of National informatic Center Office's all over Maharashtra State. - Monitoring WAN Links of 32 Districts of Maharashtra State - Visiting at Location for Troubleshooting & Installation of Network Devices. - Maintaining Down time & uptime reports of all critical Links. - Maintaining important shift wise reports. - Coordination with different ISP's for RFO & ETR such as MTNL, BSNL, PGCIL, TATA, RAILTEL, PGCIL., JIO.

Providing support to Infrastructure engineers of Central Government offices all over Maharashtra.

Providing support to Infrastructure engineers Central Government Institution all over Maharashtra

Providing support to Infrastructure engineers Central Government Hospital's all over Maharashtra

Configurations of Switches - Configurations of Routers

EDUCATION:

BE in Electronics & Telecommunications – 2020 Diploma in Electronics & Telecommunications MSBTE - 2017 SCC from Balmohan Vidyamandir - 2013

CERTIFICATE:

CCNA 2023 CSCO14444442

Cisco certified specialist enterprise SDWAN 2026 CSCO15133007

Thank you for reviewing my CV.

Reference:

Regards

Sarthak Lad

sections.label: Summary
sections.text:
OBJECTIVE:
As an engineering graduate with hands-on experience in Cisco Routers, Switches, SD-WAN, Wireless technologies, and real-time network troubleshooting, I have developed a strong foundation in the networking field. I am looking forward to working with companies where I can learn, work and grow professionally and personally.
SUMMARY:
Network Engineer with 4.8+ years of hands-on experience in managing, implementing, and troubleshooting enterprise network infrastructure.
Cisco CCNA certified and Cisco SD-WAN certified, currently pursuing CCNP Routing & Switching and Cisco SD-WAN training to further enhance technical expertise.
Proficient in supporting and resolving issues across Layer 2 and Layer 3 networks, ensuring

optimal performance and reliability. Skilled at engaging with stakeholders to deliver clear and accurate updates on projects, incidents, and service improvements.
Possess strong communication skills, both written and verbal, to collaborate effectively with customers, internal teams, and cross-functional units.
Demonstrated ability to resolve high-impact technical issues under pressure, maintaining service continuity and minimizing downtime.
Highly attentive to detail, capable of managing multiple technical priorities simultaneously in fast- paced environments.
Committed to customer satisfaction, with a strong service-oriented mindset and a focus on delivering quality support and solutions.
Working as Lead Engineer for (Latin America) region, handling critical network incidents

and service requests. Leading bridge calls with customers, ISP teams, and internal engineering teams for faster issue resolution.
Troubleshooting SD-WAN, routing, switching, MPLS, VPN related issues in real-time. - Performing L1/L2 network troubleshooting for enterprise WAN environment. - Coordinating with ISP providers for circuit outages, packet loss, latency and routing issues
SD-WAN SKILLS
Cisco SD-WAN Architecture (Controller-based design) - - WAN Edge router configuration (cEdge / vEdge) - - Application-Aware Routing (AAR) - TLOC & OMP routing concepts - SD-WAN overlay & underlay design
vManage, vSmart, vBond configuration & troubleshooting
VPN segmentation (VPN 0, 10, 512 etc.) - - - Troubleshooting SD-WAN fabric issues SD-WAN template configuration Software upgrade via vManage
